answer.main_body: Tesla coil column with brass toroid and top sphere
answer.evidence: The brass toroid ring (rows 12-17) clearly displays its top surface in 3/4 perspective with an elliptical center hole seen from above. The cylindrical base also shows foreshortened curvature at rows 39-40.

answer.main_body: copper-wound coil column with brass toroid terminal and base
answer.evidence: The brass toroid ring near the top clearly shows foreshortened 3/4 perspective with an elliptical top surface and hollow opening (rows 13-16, ~3 rows inside the hole), and the base shows rounded curvature.

answer.main_body: copper-wound coil column with brass toroid terminal and sphere
answer.evidence: The brass toroid ring capping the coil column clearly shows its top surface and center hole foreshortened in 3/4 perspective across rows 12-16 (about 4 rows tall), rather than a flat elevation profile.
The brass toroid ring below the top sphere is clearly rendered in 3/4 top-down perspective across rows 12-16, showing its upper surface and the foreshortened inner opening around the central stem.
